A [[Color/Legends|silver]] '''blaster pistol''' served as a weapon for the [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Assassin/Legends|hit-man]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]]. The [[Fluggrian/Legends|Fluggrian]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Kam Nale]] also owned one. The [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] had a round, streamlined receiver and a long narrow barrel, and heavily resembled a [[ELG-3A blaster pistol/Legends|ELG-3A blaster pistol]]. The differences were that the ELG-3A pistols did not have a trigger-guard, and the also unlike the ELG-3A this blaster did not have a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] grip, the receiver was not as smooth near the front of the [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. The gun fired green blaster bolts.

The weapon was notably used by Aldar Beedo, who commonly used the weapon, illegally, on the [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] circuits in order to perform hits. He had attempted to use the blaster while racing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]] to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]]. When not using the blaster, he kept in a holster on his [[Belt/Legends|belt]]. Kam Nale also owned a model, and attempted to use it during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], in an attempt to kill Aldar Beedo. He too failed, however.
